text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Three Musketeers] in text: Cost 2

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 card with the [Appmon] or [Three Musketeers] trait from your hand or trash as any of your Digimon's bottom digivolution card, gain 1 memory.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] ＜Draw 2＞ and trash 2 cards in your hand.

extracted.name: Scopemon

qa.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.
qa.question: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?

qa.answer:
The BT21-054 [Shotmon] linked with this card is trashed upon the rule check timing.
